svg.title: Gaming panda
svg.desc: A headset-wearing panda eats burgers. Each bite pops a role card in front of its mouth and a quote on the side panel. Roles: Game Programmer, Blender, Unreal Engine, CI/CD Manager, Debugger, Animator, C++ Hunter, Game Designer, Web Scraper, FPS and GPU Scaling, Unity, System Quality Tester, Scalable System Designer, Quality Assurance Check.
